# AliExpress

> AliExpress is a global ecommerce marketplace where consumers buy products from international sellers and merchants manage cross-border sales.

AliExpress, part of Alibaba International, combines consumer shopping, order management, buyer protection, affiliate tools, and seller services across many product categories and regions.

## Shopping & Discovery
- [Home](https://www.aliexpress.com/): Main marketplace homepage for browsing products, deals, and category-based shopping.
- [All Categories](https://www.aliexpress.com/category/all-wholesale-products.html): Category directory for exploring products across major marketplace departments.
- [Flash Deals](https://www.aliexpress.com/gcp/300000512/flash-deals): Time-limited promotional offers across popular product categories.
- [SuperDeals](https://www.aliexpress.com/gcp/300000533/superdeals): Discount-focused shopping page featuring curated low-price product selections.
- [Choice](https://www.aliexpress.com/gcp/300000582/choice-channel): Curated shopping program highlighting selected products with shipping and service benefits.
- [AliExpress Plaza](https://www.aliexpress.com/gcp/300000358/plaza): Local warehouse and faster-delivery shopping area for selected markets.
- [New Arrivals](https://www.aliexpress.com/w/wholesale-new-arrivals.html): Product discovery page focused on newly listed marketplace items.

## Buyer Account & Orders
- [Login](https://login.aliexpress.com/): Buyer sign-in entry point for accessing accounts and orders.
- [Register](https://login.aliexpress.com/join.htm): Account creation page for new AliExpress users.
- [My Orders](https://trade.aliexpress.com/orderList.htm): Order history and order management area for buyers.
- [My AliExpress](https://home.aliexpress.com/): Buyer account dashboard for profile, orders, messages, and settings.
- [Message Center](https://message.aliexpress.com/): Messaging interface for communication between buyers and sellers.
- [Wish List](https://my.aliexpress.com/wishlist/wish_list_product_list.htm): Saved products list for future purchase consideration.
- [Shopping Cart](https://shoppingcart.aliexpress.com/shopcart/shopcartDetail.htm): Cart management page for reviewing intended purchases before checkout.

## Customer Service & Protection
- [Help Center](https://service.aliexpress.com/): Central support portal for buyer help and service topics.
- [Buyer Protection](https://sale.aliexpress.com/__pc/buyerprotection/index.htm): Overview of marketplace protections covering delivery, refunds, and order issues.
- [Disputes & Refunds](https://service.aliexpress.com/page/knowledge?pageId=37&category=1000021992&knowledge=1060015216&language=en): Help content about opening disputes and requesting refunds.
- [Report Intellectual Property Infringement](https://ipp.alibabagroup.com/): Alibaba Group portal for reporting IP-related complaints and violations.
- [Contact Us](https://service.aliexpress.com/page/home): Support home for navigating self-service and customer assistance options.
- [Open a Dispute](https://trade.aliexpress.com/issue/issueList.htm): Buyer dispute management page for order problem resolution.

## Shipping, Payment & Returns
- [Shipping Information](https://service.aliexpress.com/page/knowledge?pageId=37&category=1000021992&knowledge=1060015072&language=en): Help article covering shipping methods, tracking, and delivery expectations.
- [Payment Methods](https://service.aliexpress.com/page/knowledge?pageId=37&category=1000021992&knowledge=1060015077&language=en): Support information about accepted payment options and processing.
- [Return & Refund Policy](https://sale.aliexpress.com/__pc/refund_policy.htm): Policy page describing return eligibility and refund handling.
- [Track Order](https://global.cainiao.com/): Shipment tracking portal commonly used for AliExpress order logistics.
- [Free Return](https://sale.aliexpress.com/__pc/free_return.htm): Program information for eligible free-return orders and conditions.

## Seller & Business Services
- [AliExpress Seller Center](https://seller.aliexpress.com/): Main portal for merchants managing stores, listings, and operations.
- [Seller Login](https://login.aliexpress.com/seller.htm): Sign-in page for merchant and seller accounts.
- [Global Selling](https://sell.aliexpress.com/): Seller acquisition site for businesses interested in opening an AliExpress store.
- [Seller University](https://university.aliexpress.com/): Training and educational resources for marketplace sellers.
- [Dropshipping Center](https://ds.aliexpress.com/): Seller and sourcing tools commonly used for dropshipping workflows.
- [Business Blog](https://sell.aliexpress.com/__pc/newsellerblog.htm): Articles and updates for merchants selling on AliExpress.

## Affiliate & Creator Programs
- [AliExpress Portals](https://portals.aliexpress.com/): Affiliate platform for publishers, creators, and traffic partners.
- [Affiliate Program](https://portals.aliexpress.com/affiportals/web/portals.htm): Program overview and tools for earning commissions from referrals.
- [Creator Connections](https://portals.aliexpress.com/affiportals/web/creator_connection.htm): Affiliate resources tailored to content creators and influencers.
- [Hot Products](https://portals.aliexpress.com/affiportals/web/publisher_hot_product.htm): Affiliate product discovery page featuring promotable items.
- [Coupon Center](https://portals.aliexpress.com/affiportals/web/coupon_center.htm): Affiliate-accessible coupon listings for promotional campaigns.

## Mobile Apps & Tools
- [AliExpress Android App](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.alibaba.aliexpresshd): Android app for mobile shopping, account access, and order tracking.
- [AliExpress iOS App](https://apps.apple.com/app/aliexpress-shopping-app/id436672029): iPhone and iPad app for browsing products and managing purchases.
- [App Download](https://www.aliexpress.com/app): Official app download landing page for mobile users.
- [Currency Selector](https://www.aliexpress.com/): Marketplace interface supports localized currency and region selection.
- [Language Selector](https://www.aliexpress.com/): Marketplace interface supports multiple languages for international buyers.

## Policies & Legal
- [Terms of Use](https://rulechannel.aliexpress.com/pcRule.htm?type=detail&ruleId=2042001&cId=118): Terms governing use of the AliExpress marketplace and services.
- [Privacy Policy](https://rulechannel.aliexpress.com/pcRule.htm?type=detail&ruleId=20587497&cId=325): Privacy terms describing data collection and processing practices.
- [Cookie Preferences](https://www.aliexpress.com/): Site interface includes cookie consent and preference management.
- [Intellectual Property Protection Rules](https://rulechannel.aliexpress.com/pcRule.htm?type=detail&ruleId=2042002&cId=118): Rules related to intellectual property compliance on the platform.
- [Transaction Services Agreement](https://rulechannel.aliexpress.com/pcRule.htm?type=detail&ruleId=2042003&cId=118): Agreement covering transaction-related services and marketplace responsibilities.

## Promotions & Programs
- [Coupon Center](https://www.aliexpress.com/gcp/300000311/coupon-center): Central page for browsing available marketplace coupons and discounts.
- [AliExpress Bonus](https://www.aliexpress.com/gcp/300000526/bonus): Promotional rewards and savings program information.
- [Coins & Rewards](https://www.aliexpress.com/gcp/300000313/coin-channel): Loyalty-style page for earning and using AliExpress coins.
- [Anniversary Sale](https://www.aliexpress.com/gcp/300000376/anniversary-sale): Seasonal campaign landing page for a major AliExpress sales event.
- [Black Friday](https://www.aliexpress.com/gcp/300000377/black-friday): Promotional landing page for Black Friday marketplace deals.
